card.fact_statement: The orbit of 2025 GN1 is estimated to precess at a rate of 52.6 arcseconds per century.
card.source_span: Its orbit is estimated to precess at a rate of 52.6 arcseconds per century—faster than Mercury's apsidal precession rate.
